A1.justification: Both complete 34-page PDFs describe the same min-p sampling work. Text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison. Rendered pages are identical except for the arXiv stamp and localized changes on page 3.

before.justification: Sections 5–6 report original benchmark experiments and human evaluations. Appendices B–C include additional benchmark, human-study and constrained creative-writing results.

after.justification: v8 retains the original experimental results in Sections 5–6 and Appendices B–C, including the refined human evaluation and structured creative-writing evaluation.

M1.justification: The confidence-scaled threshold, token selection and normalized sampling procedure in Section 3 and the implementation in Appendix A.1 are unchanged. The caption correction introduces no method component.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same GPQA, GSM8K, AlpacaEval creative-writing, human-evaluation and constrained-generation coverage. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding main-text and appendix experiments, including temperature-only, top-k, top-p, eta, epsilon and Mirostat comparisons.

E3.justification: Model configurations, prompting, temperature and threshold sweeps, evaluation metrics, automated judging and both human-study protocols are unchanged, including their appendix descriptions.

E4.justification: The case studies, Figure 2 accuracy–diversity analysis, hyperparameter ablations, combined-sampler tests and supplementary analyses in Appendices B–C are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Confidence intervals in Table 7, standard errors in Tables 4 and 15, seed/run information and statistical-analysis descriptions in Appendix C are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1–18 and the results plotted in Figure 2 are unchanged. No experimental result entries, rankings or qualitative findings are added, removed or revised.

T1.justification: Equations 1–3, the mathematical examples in Appendix A.4 and the sampling definitions in Appendix D.2 are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about novelty, balancing quality and diversity, high-temperature performance and community adoption.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, result interpretations and limitations remain unchanged. The revised caption identifies existing panels more accurately without adding a substantive interpretation; Section 3.2 retains its old panel descriptions.

D1.justification: Implementation code, hyperparameter guidance, runtime information, survey and judging details, and code/data access information are unchanged across the main text and appendices.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list and positioning relative to prior sampling methods are unchanged, including the contrastive-decoding discussion and Appendix D.2.

P1.justification: Figure 1 receives a localized caption rewrite, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose, section organization and appendices are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1's caption replaces incorrect panel descriptions with top-p at high certainty, top-k at low certainty, and min-p at high and low certainty for panels (a)–(d). Method names are bolded, with minor page-3 reflow. The plots themselves and all other figures and tables are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v8 corrects Figure 1's misleading caption to match the existing plots, improving the accuracy of a central method illustration. The benefit is limited: scientific content and evidence are unchanged, and Section 3.2 still repeats the incorrect panel mapping.
